items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: He was ambitious and also Huey and Alan, man.

ctx.x: Well most of your guys, you were, I mean, who were a little older than, say, Earl and Alan, those people, did you all, was everybody really helpful to the younger guys in general?
Yeah. Yeah, man. Yeah. But man, I knew Earl was going to make it some kind of way when he can't push stuff, come around and drill and drive. He was ambitious and also Huey and Alan, man.
What do you mean ambitious? What do you mean Earl was ambitious?
